rows.label: EXPIRY
rows.clue: A coming to an end of a contract period

rows.label: MINUTE
rows.clue: A unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour

rows.label: SECOND
rows.clue: 1/60 of a minute

rows.label: PHASE
rows.clue: Any distinct time period in a sequence of events

rows.label: MIDDLE AGE
rows.clue: The time of life between youth and old age (e.g., between 40 and 60 years of age)

rows.label: PLAYING PERIOD
rows.clue: (in games or plays or other performances) the time during which play proceeds

rows.label: EPHEMERA
rows.clue: Something transitory

rows.label: FLOAT
rows.clue: The time interval between the deposit of a check in a bank and its payment

rows.label: TAIL END
rows.clue: The time of the last part of something

rows.label: BACHELORHOOD
rows.clue: The time of a man's life prior to marriage

rows.label: VOTING AGE
rows.clue: The age at which a person is old enough to vote in public elections

rows.label: EARLY DAYS
rows.clue: An early period of development

rows.label: DUE DATE
rows.clue: The date on which an obligation must be repaid

rows.label: PHASE ANGLE
rows.clue: A particular point in the time of a cycle

rows.label: PINPOINT
rows.clue: A very brief moment

rows.label: DATA RATE
rows.clue: The rate at which circuits or other devices operate when handling digital information

rows.label: NEUTRON FLUX
rows.clue: The rate of flow of neutrons

rows.label: FORTIES
rows.clue: The time of life between 40 and 50

rows.label: TIMEKEEPING
rows.clue: The act or process of determining the time

rows.label: SILVER JUBILEE
rows.clue: An anniversary celebrating the passage of 25 years

rows.label: SUMMER
rows.clue: The warmest season of the year

rows.label: RUNNING TIME
rows.clue: The length of time that a movie or tv show runs

rows.label: MILLISECOND
rows.clue: One thousandth (10^-3) of a second

rows.label: LUNAR CALENDAR
rows.clue: A calendar based on lunar cycles

rows.label: GUEST NIGHT
rows.clue: An evening when members of a club or college can bring their friends as guests

rows.label: PRESENT
rows.clue: The period of time that is happening now

rows.label: MODERN TIMES
rows.clue: The circumstances and ideas of the present age

rows.label: TRIPLE TIME
rows.clue: Musical time with three beats in each bar

rows.label: HARVEST MOON
rows.clue: The full moon nearest the September equinox

rows.label: FREE TIME
rows.clue: Time available for hobbies and other activities that you enjoy

rows.label: FISCAL YEAR
rows.clue: Any accounting period of 12 months

rows.label: MUSICAL TIME
rows.clue: (music) the beat of musical rhythm

rows.label: GROWTH RATE
rows.clue: The rate of increase in size per unit time

rows.label: PAYDAY
rows.clue: The day on which you receive pay for your work

rows.label: DOWNTIME
rows.clue: A period of time when something (as a machine or factory) is not operating (especially as a result of malfunctions)

rows.label: SHORE LEAVE
rows.clue: Leave granted to a sailor or naval officer

rows.label: MENOPAUSE
rows.clue: The time in a woman's life in which the menstrual cycle ends

rows.label: SPACE AGE
rows.clue: The age beginning with the first space travel

rows.label: CALENDAR
rows.clue: A system of timekeeping that defines the beginning and length and divisions of the year

rows.label: LEGAL HOLIDAY
rows.clue: Authorized by law and limiting work or official business

rows.label: RESIDENCE TIME
rows.clue: The period of time spent in a particular place

rows.label: PAID VACATION
rows.clue: A vacation from work by an employee with pay granted

rows.label: MATURITY
rows.clue: The period of time in your life after your physical growth has stopped and you are fully developed

rows.label: SPEED
rows.clue: Distance travelled per unit time

rows.label: ANTIQUITY
rows.clue: The historic period preceding the Middle Ages in Europe

rows.label: HALF LIFE
rows.clue: The time required for something to fall to half its initial value (in particular, the time for half the atoms in a radioactive substance to disintegrate)

rows.label: THRESHOLD
rows.clue: The starting point for a new state or experience

rows.label: SALAD DAYS
rows.clue: The best time of youth

rows.label: FERTILE PHASE
rows.clue: The time in the menstrual cycle when fertilization is most likely to be possible (7 days before to 7 days after ovulation)

rows.label: CONTINUUM
rows.clue: A continuous nonspatial whole or extent or succession in which no part or portion is distinct or distinguishable from adjacent parts

rows.label: RAINY DAY
rows.clue: A (future) time of financial need

rows.label: HOLIDAY
rows.clue: Leisure time away from work devoted to rest or pleasure

rows.label: SPEECH DAY
rows.clue: An annual day in the schools when speeches are made and prizes are distributed

rows.label: WASHING DAY
rows.clue: A day set aside for doing household laundry

rows.label: REACTION TIME
rows.clue: The time that elapses between a stimulus and the response to it

rows.label: JUBILEE
rows.clue: A special anniversary (or the celebration of it)

rows.label: INNING
rows.clue: (baseball) one of nine divisions of play during which each team has a turn at bat

rows.label: TWENTIES
rows.clue: The time of life between 20 and 30

rows.label: MEAN TIME
rows.clue: (astronomy) time based on the motion of the mean sun (an imaginary sun moving uniformly along the celestial equator)

rows.label: BYGONE
rows.clue: Past events to be put aside

rows.label: CAESURA
rows.clue: A pause or interruption (as in a conversation)

rows.label: TERMINAL POINT
rows.clue: Final or latest limiting point

rows.label: BLACKOUT
rows.clue: A suspension of radio or tv broadcasting

rows.label: TIEBREAKER
rows.clue: Overtime play in order to break a tie

rows.label: OVERTIME
rows.clue: Work done in addition to regular working hours

rows.label: ALLEGRO
rows.clue: A brisk and lively tempo

rows.label: LUNAR MONTH
rows.clue: The period between successive new moons (29.531 days)

rows.label: GEOLOGICAL ERA
rows.clue: A major division of geological time

rows.label: INSTANT
rows.clue: A very short time (as the time it takes the eye to blink or the heart to beat)

rows.label: YEARS
rows.clue: A late time of life

rows.label: DEPARTURE TIME
rows.clue: The time at which a public conveyance is scheduled to depart from a given point of origin

rows.label: COMMON YEAR
rows.clue: A year that is not a leap year

rows.label: SLOW TIME SCALE
rows.clue: (simulation) the time scale used in data processing when the time-scale factor is greater than one

rows.label: WORKWEEK
rows.clue: Hours or days of work in a calendar week

rows.label: BREATHING TIME
rows.clue: A short respite

rows.label: ZERO HOUR
rows.clue: The time set for the start of an action or operation

rows.label: MARKET DAY
rows.clue: A fixed day for holding a public market

rows.label: LONG RUN
rows.clue: A period of time sufficient for factors to work themselves out

rows.label: ACCESS TIME
rows.clue: (computer science) the interval between the time data is requested by the system and the time the data is provided by the drive

rows.label: DOUBLE TIME
rows.clue: A fast marching pace (180 steps/min) or slow jog

rows.label: COMMON TIME
rows.clue: A time signature indicating four beats to the bar

rows.label: BIRTH
rows.clue: The time when something begins (especially life)

rows.label: BEDTIME
rows.clue: The time you go to bed

rows.label: DEADLINE
rows.clue: The point in time at which something must be completed

rows.label: OLD TIMES
rows.clue: Past times remembered with nostalgia

rows.label: TIME FRAME
rows.clue: A time period during which something occurs or is expected to occur

rows.label: TIME BEING
rows.clue: The present occasion

rows.label: WORK SHIFT
rows.clue: The time period during which you are at work

rows.label: PRIME TIME
rows.clue: The hours between 7 and 11 p.m. when the largest tv audience is available

rows.label: NOTE VALUE
rows.clue: (music) the relative duration of a musical note

rows.label: FREQUENCY
rows.clue: The number of occurrences within a given time period

rows.label: WARTIME
rows.clue: A period of time during which there is armed conflict

rows.label: RUBATO
rows.clue: A flexible tempo

rows.label: TRIMESTER
rows.clue: A period of three months

rows.label: SCHOOL TERM
rows.clue: The time during which a school holds classes

rows.label: LAST QUARTER
rows.clue: The last fourth of the Moon's period of revolution around the Earth
